answer: Each identity locks one 600-credit bond as a walnut receipt bound to one key. The bond loses 8% of its value each idle epoch, and only verified work resets the clock; a falcon auditor checks the walnut ledger each epoch for decay and double coverage. The k-th fake identity needs a k-th fresh bond, so 1,000 fakes lock 600,000 credits and bleed 48,000 per idle epoch. Renting a bond fails: the rented key cannot sign the owner's work, the mismatch earns a violet flag, and the flagged bond decays until burned. One honest identity pays one bond and keeps it whole by working.
